plan.title: Price-based auction shows lowest bid without rank

steps.note: Open the single-stage create flow required for selecting a Price Based auction.
Configure the auction as Price Based with whole-lot awarding.

args.title: Price Based Lowest Bid Visibility Test

steps.note: Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Create one item so the lowest-price assertion maps directly to the only item.
Invite at least two vendors so the auction has competing bids.
Publish the configured Price Based auction.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a lower bid for the other invited vendor to establish the lowest price.
Confirm the competing lower bid was accepted.
Inspect the invited vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Assert the vendor screen shows the lowest bid price for the item.
Assert the Price Based vendor view does not expose rank information.
